d:
The Pistons defeated the Wizards, 122-111 tonight in Detroit. John Collins contributed a team-high 24 points to go with 10 rebounds 3 assists and 2 steals, with Duncan Robinson of the Pistons adding an additional 22 points (6-11 FG, 4-8 3P) in the game. Anthony Davis finished with a team-high 44 points along with 13 rebounds for the Wizards in the losing effort. The Pistons improve their record to 7-3 with the win, while the Wizards fall to 4-7 for the season.
